title: Nell and the Sock
note: b414 — Phase 3 complete (air, ure, er) and Phase 4 begins (Learning) — first consonant clusters bl, br, cl, cr.

pages.brief: Nell the bee flying near a washing rail strung between two posts.
A large red sock pegged to the washing rail, blocking the view behind it.
Nell the bee trying to peer around the red sock but unable to see past it.
Nell the bee humming loudly beside the red sock.
Fig the caterpillar on the other side of the washing rail, humming back.
Nell the bee with her head tilted, listening carefully to the faint humming sound.
Nell the bee flying past the edge of the red sock, following the sound.
Nell the bee spotting Fig the caterpillar sitting on the grass on the other side.
Nell the bee and Fig the caterpillar together, both looking delighted.
